北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，但体感 2℃，早晚注意添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, but feels like 2℃. Dress warmly, especially in the mornings/evenings!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天有北风，体感-1℃，多穿点，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a north wind, feels like -1℃. Bundle up to stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温 7℃，感觉有点凉。注意保暖哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, 7℃. It feels a bit chilly, stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，但风力 5级，体感 12℃，注意防风哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny but windy (level 5), feels like 12℃. Mind the wind!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 15℃。早晚温差大，别忘了加件外套哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, feels like 15℃. Big temp difference, bring a jacket for evenings!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 2℃，湿冷感强。多穿点，照顾好自己！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 2℃ and damp. Dress warmly and take care!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感 4℃。外出请戴口罩，注意保暖防寒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is hazy, feels like 4℃. Wear a mask and stay warm if going out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 9℃。微凉的天气，别忘了喝杯热茶！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 9℃. A bit cool, maybe a warm cup of tea?

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 7℃。湿润微冷，注意添衣别感冒！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 7℃. Damp and cool, add layers to avoid colds!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，但体感 0℃。出门要穿暖和点，小心感冒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels like 0℃. Dress very warmly when out, avoid catching a cold!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 9℃。湿冷，出门注意保暖防潮哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 9℃. Damp and cool, dress warmly and mind the humidity!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨零下十几度，体感 -16℃！全副武装才能出门哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -16℃! Bundle up completely before heading out!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 -10℃。很冷哦，多穿几层是王道！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -10℃. Very cold, layering is key!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，但风力 4级。体感 9℃，记得带件外套！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny but windy (level 4), feels like 9℃. Remember a jacket!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 19℃。天气舒适，享受好时光！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 19℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy your day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 0℃。风大体感冷，注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but feels like 0℃. Windy and cold, dress warmly and mind the wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴天，体感 -4℃。寒风刺骨，出门注意保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny, feels like -4℃. Biting wind, stay warm when going out!
